### Racing the methods beats every fixed rule, and where it does not is measurable

Chosen at the cheaper budget on even seeds, paid at the dearer on odd seeds, so
no run appears on both sides. Every budget pair is scored, not only the extremes.
Each entry is mean +/- sd / worst regret against the best method on the
paying seeds; the sd is the scatter across the cells of that group, not
across seeds.

| cells | n | race | always ACO | always ILS | always PSO |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| all cells | 61 | 0.51% +/- 1.38% / 8.90% | 5.13% +/- 9.42% / 31.91% | 3.11% +/- 6.09% / 27.61% | 1.87% +/- 3.24% / 11.29% |
| sharp top (one winner) | 39 | 0.80% +/- 1.67% / 8.90% | 7.97% +/- 10.82% / 31.91% | 4.29% +/- 7.21% / 27.61% | 2.81% +/- 3.74% / 11.29% |
| plateau top (methods tie) | 22 | 0.00% +/- 0.00% / 0.00% | 0.09% +/- 0.26% / 1.15% | 1.01% +/- 2.20% / 9.61% | 0.22% +/- 0.26% / 0.92% |

Where the plateau rows are exactly zero the choice costs nothing, so an
average over both kinds understates what the selector is for. Splitting the
regret by which term of the racing bound carries it, over 200 race draws per
size with the paying half held fixed:

| term | cells over 1% | mean | sd | worst |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| estimation: finite race seeds, shrinks as they grow | 6 | 0.30% | 1.53% | 8.90% |
| transfer: the cheap budget ranks methods differently | 2 | 0.22% | 0.63% | 4.46% |
